name: Acceptance suite-3 test 57 - escaped key \u0041ction decodes to Action -> BLOCKED
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign A. The member name \u0041ction JSON-escape-decodes to 'Action', colliding with the literal Action member. Duplicate detection must compare DECODED member names, not raw source spelling, so a regex-only duplicate check that compares raw spans would miss this. Must fail closed with DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY at Statement[0].Action.
rationale: JSON string escapes are semantically transparent: \u0041 IS the character 'A', so "\u0041ction" and "Action" are the same member name. Duplicate detection has to run on the post-decode name to resist an evasion that hides a second Action behind an escape sequence. Ref: RFC 8259 section 7 (string escapes) + section 4 (member uniqueness).
